title: cyrtomium falcatum
intro: Cyrtomium falcatum, commonly known as the net vein spleenwort or fox tail fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cyrtomium falcatum include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties. Its bioactive constituents include triterpenoid saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, and other compounds such as flavonoids and phenolic acids that contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
